brock_yokley: Clement "Saint" Yokley was a tailor in Esterhaus until the posters went up. He came to R-F11 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole bay knew that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Clement "Saint" Yokley was number 35. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
ebrrrvole: Jakub Ebrrrvole signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Jakub Ebrrrvole was number 65. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Jakub Ebrrrvole received a photograph taken outside the family home. He studied the unfamiliar curtains longer than the faces.
jackmdunn06: Isidor Jackmdunn came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Isidor Jackmdunn was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Isidor Jackmdunn asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Isidor Jackmdunn counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin.
wolfmanantony: Nils Wolfmananton came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
A bullet went through Nils Wolfmananton's sleeve at S-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).
The medics cleaned Nils Wolfmananton's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8.
